events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic double album, 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Release
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' upon the world. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Timeless Classic
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible.

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Gone But Not Forgotten
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. Forever pushing boundaries.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy 92nd birthday to the legend, Elvis Presley. The King's influence on music is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page turns 83 today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock music.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop legend Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today.

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart! A career full of hits.

events.title: Suggs (Madness) turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) turns 66 today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young turns 71 today.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That voice defined a generation of smooth pop and soul.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. She passed away on August 25, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her legacy shines brighter than ever.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow turns 56 today.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a true British pop institution.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean turns 77 today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! His hits still make us want to 'Get Outta My Dreams'.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inaugural ceremony anniversary
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that first class?
